ex.en: Student protesters clashed with police outside the city hall yesterday morning.
ex.zh: 昨天上午，抗议学生在市政厅外与警察发生冲突。

words.note: 多指意见、利益冲突，也指双方人马相撞。

ex.en: The appeal court overturned the original verdict after reviewing new evidence.
ex.zh: 上诉法院在审查新证据后推翻了原判决。

words.note: 本义是翻转，引申为推翻判决、决定或政权。

ex.en: Bad weather compelled the airline to cancel several flights this morning.
ex.zh: 恶劣天气迫使航空公司取消了今天上午的多趟航班。

words.note: 用法是 compel sb to do sth，被动表被迫。

ex.en: The steady rise in prices has depressed consumer spending across the country.
ex.zh: 物价持续上涨压低了全国的消费支出。

words.note: de-(向下)加 press(压)：压下、使沮丧、使不景气。

ex.en: She is perfectly capable of handling the project on her own.
ex.zh: 她完全有能力独自处理这个项目。

words.note: 常用 be capable of doing，比 able 更强调能力。

ex.en: Rising rents have become a heavy burden on young families in big cities.
ex.zh: 不断上涨的房租已成为大城市年轻家庭的沉重负担。

words.note: 可数名词，常用 a burden on sb；动词表使负担。

ex.en: The soldiers saluted the flag as the national anthem began to play.
ex.zh: 国歌奏响时，士兵们向国旗敬礼。

words.note: 指军队敬礼或公开赞扬，salute sb for sth 表赞扬。

ex.en: She clasped the letter tightly in her hands and began to cry.
ex.zh: 她把信紧紧握在手里，哭了起来。

words.note: 作名词指搭扣，作动词指紧握、抱紧。

ex.en: The university will hold a symposium on climate change next month.
ex.zh: 这所大学下个月将举办一场关于气候变化的研讨会。

words.note: 指学术性研讨会，比 meeting 更专、规模更小。

ex.en: A helicopter hovered over the stadium during the whole match.
ex.zh: 整场比赛期间，一架直升机在体育场上空盘旋。

words.note: 指鸟或飞机在空中盘旋，也指人在近处徘徊。

ex.en: Officers stopped drivers at random to check their licences.
ex.zh: 执法人员随机拦下司机检查驾照。

words.note: at random 表随机地，random 一般无比较级。

ex.en: We dined at a small restaurant near the river last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚我们在河边一家小餐馆用餐。

words.note: dine out 指外出用餐，dine with sb 与某人共餐。

ex.en: Her warm personality makes her popular with both clients and colleagues.
ex.zh: 她热情的性格使她深受客户和同事的欢迎。

words.note: 指个人稳定的性格，也可指名人；作名词可数。

ex.en: The government imposed sanctions on several companies for breaking trade rules.
ex.zh: 政府因多家公司违反贸易规定而对其实施制裁。

words.note: 作制裁义常用复数 sanctions，作批准义表许可。

ex.en: Drivers should stay alert when the road is covered with ice.
ex.zh: 路面结冰时，司机应保持警惕。

words.note: stay alert 保持警惕，be on alert 处于戒备状态。

ex.en: From these clues the detective deduced who had entered the room.
ex.zh: 侦探根据这些线索推断出谁进过这个房间。

words.note: de-(出)加 duce(引导)：把结论引出来，即推断。

ex.en: An old oak tree still stands in the middle of the village.
ex.zh: 村子中央仍矗立着一棵老橡树。

words.note: 指栎树或橡木；作树木可数，作木材不可数。

ex.en: The lawyer met her client to discuss the details of the case.
ex.zh: 律师与当事人会面，讨论案件的细节。

words.note: 指律师、银行的客户或委托人，一般不指普通顾客。

ex.en: She sipped her tea slowly while reading the morning paper.
ex.zh: 她一边看晨报，一边慢慢啜着茶。

words.note: 指小口地喝，take a sip 即喝一小口。

ex.en: He was a dutiful son who visited his parents every weekend.
ex.zh: 他是个孝顺的儿子，每个周末都去看望父母。

words.note: 由 duty(责任)加 -ful 构成：尽职的、恭顺的。

ex.en: Critics contend that the new law will hurt small businesses.
ex.zh: 批评者认为新法将损害小企业。

words.note: contend with 应对困难，contend that 主张、声称。

phr.en: the conversion of A into B

ex.en: The conversion of the old factory into apartments took three years.
ex.zh: 把旧工厂改造成公寓花了三年时间。

words.note: con-(完全)加 vert(转)：彻底转变，也指皈依。

ex.en: She came up with a brilliant idea for cutting production costs.
ex.zh: 她想出了一个降低生产成本的妙主意。

words.note: 强调才华出众或光线明亮，口语里也表很棒。

ex.en: Investing all his savings in one company was a huge gamble.
ex.zh: 把所有积蓄投进一家公司是一场巨大的赌博。

words.note: gamble on 表冒险押注，take a gamble 冒险一试。

ex.en: Prices are bound to rise if the drought continues another month.
ex.zh: 如果干旱再持续一个月，价格必然上涨。

words.note: be bound to do 表必定，be bound by 表受约束。

ex.en: The parts were rejected because they did not meet the specifications.
ex.zh: 这些零件因不符合规格而被退回。

words.note: 常用复数，meet the specifications 指符合规格。

ex.en: Two foreign workers were deported for entering the country illegally.
ex.zh: 两名外籍工人因非法入境被驱逐出境。

words.note: 指把外国人驱逐出境，deport sb from a country。

ex.en: She bought two tickets at the counter near the entrance.
ex.zh: 她在入口附近的柜台买了两张票。

words.note: 指柜台或计数器，over the counter 指非处方。

ex.en: The drummer kept a steady rhythm throughout the whole song.
ex.zh: 鼓手在整首歌中保持了稳定的节奏。

words.note: 指节奏、韵律，重音在首音节，拼写注意 th。

ex.en: The doctor explained the operation in layman's terms so the family could understand.
ex.zh: 医生用通俗的话解释手术，好让家属听懂。

words.note: in layman's terms 指用外行也听得懂的话说。
